objective: Help service-desk users troubleshoot incidents from internal documentation and open an engineering ticket when escalation is required.
unresolved_blockers: Identify the authoritative ticket system, supported create operation, action boundary, and identity before selecting an executable integration.

harness.rationale: Default harness is sufficient absent a stated architectural reason to use another harness.
harness.dependency: Validate supported authoring access during preflight.

knowledge.rationale: The objective explicitly requires troubleshooting grounded in internal documentation.
knowledge.dependency: Identify authoritative location and access during preflight.

skills.selection: Procedural troubleshooting skill if steps are reusable
skills.rationale: A skill is justified only if incident procedures provide reusable multi-step guidance.

tools_actions.selection: Ticket creation action, provider and operation pending clarification
tools_actions.rationale: Opening an engineering ticket is an external side effect requiring an approved action path.
tools_actions.dependency: Ticket system, operation, identity, permissions, and confirmation policy are unresolved.

power_automate.selection: Unresolved; choose only if deterministic workflow needs branching, multiple connectors, retries, or recovery
power_automate.rationale: The objective alone does not establish workflow complexity.
power_automate.dependency: Resolve ticket operation and behavior before selecting the execution path.

dataverse_state.rationale: No structured durable application data or workflow state is stated.

agents.rationale: Troubleshooting and escalation belong to one service-desk responsibility.

external_integrations.selection: None selected until ticket system is named
external_integrations.rationale: The objective does not identify a provider or authoritative system.
external_integrations.dependency: Clarify system and allowed ticket operation.

custom_development.rationale: Evaluate native action, connector, and flow options after the required operation is known.
